The Opportunity:


The Quotient Inside AI Product Enablement Analyst is part of the AI Capability & Adoption team at Oliver Wyman. Working within a global Centre of Excellence, you will help colleagues across the firm build practical AI fluency - turning curiosity into confident, responsible use. You will shape how AI tools are used across the firm, using the most underrated tool in AI: precise writing.


Working closely with the Director of AI Product Enablement and the Product Strategy leadership team, the Analyst contributes to coaching support, prompt refinement, AI assistant evaluation, and enablement materials that help scale responsible AI adoption across the firm.


This is a hands-on enablement role with real scope to grow. If you enjoy testing and refining until something works, explaining complex things simply, and writing with precision, this role will feel like home. You will be supported to develop deeper AI expertise as you go - no two days will look the same.


Key Responsibilities:


Prompt & Skill Writing

  • Write clear, reusable prompts, skills, and structured guides that help colleagues get consistent, reliable results from AI tools
  • Refine prompts and skills for practical team use, turning fuzzy requests into precise, unambiguous instructions
  • Validate outputs for clarity, consistency, safety, and usability

AI Workflow Design

  • Map how a task should flow through an AI-supported workflow: defining steps, decision points, and handoffs in plain language
  • Test prompts and workflows against real use cases, spot where instructions break down, and refine the wording until it works
  • Explore AI tools to understand their strengths, limitations, and best-fit use cases - and document what you learn in reusable form

Documentation & Living Exemplars

  • Co-create and maintain prompt libraries, living exemplars, and structured guides for the Centre of Excellence
  • Document tested use cases in reusable formats
  • Contribute technical examples and demos to training and enablement materials

Coaching Support & Community Engagement

  • Support office hours and working sessions
  • Help translate user questions into structured AI prompts or Product Strategy team actions and backlog items
  • Guide colleagues toward the right resources, tools, and exemplars
  • Respond to inbound AI questions with patience, clarity, and practical advice

Pattern Awareness & Feedback

  • Track recurring questions and usage patterns
  • Share structured observations with the AI Product Strategy team leads
  • Contribute technical input to decks and enablement documentation


Experience Required

- Around 2 years of experience in technical writing, translation or localisation, instructional design, editorial work, knowledge management, consulting communications, digital enablement, or a related field - or a portfolio of practical work that shows equivalent skill

- Practical experience implementing AI in real work: examples could include prompts or workflows you built and refined, AI-assisted processes you introduced to a team, or documented use cases you tested and improved

- Experience writing structured documentation, technical guides, style guides, or instructional content in a collaborative environment.

This role does not involve building LLM pipelines, RAG systems, model fine-tuning, or ML infrastructure - no coding background is required.

The craft is language, structure, and design, not code


Skills and Attributes :

- Exceptional written clarity: you can turn a fuzzy request into precise, unambiguous instructions, and you think about how words will be interpreted - by a person or by a model

- Experience writing structured content: documentation, guides, translations, training materials, or editorial work

- Curious and experimentation driven - you enjoy testing how wording changes AI output

- Detail-oriented and reliable - you notice ambiguity, inconsistency, and gaps that others miss

- Analytical mindset and attention to detail

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

- A genuine learning orientation - energised by new challenges, not daunted by them
